description: strikta.dev guard: blocks paths outside this repository, generated-text edits, production and unsafe git.

hooks.command: node "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tool/guard.ts" || { code=$?; [ $code -eq 2 ] || echo "Blocked: the guard failed to run (exit $code)" >&2; exit 2; }
hooks.statusMessage: Checking the call against the website guard
